title: First PvE test of my indie MMORPG
author: WideWorry
selftext:
Hi,

I’ve built a workflow that let me rebalance encounters based on the current state of the game, using Monte Carlo method, it does tune timers, hp, damage, size of AoE, number of the summoned packs, so not only tune the HP or damage, but find a proper mixture off every aspect.  


Maybe this will be later added into the game, a simulation takes like \~5 second after we measured classes, so encounters will be adjusted to the team and not the team to the encounters.

The current test encounter has an 80% wipe rate against bot players, whose only limitation is a random reaction-time penalty when responding to objectives.

Claude (Fable/Opus) and ChatGPT are used during development.

It is an engineer, it use bow as a weapon and can shoot special arrows like, electric, fire.  Can place turrets. And probably can use robots as pet, not sure it will be unique fro this class.

In lore perspective Tinkerers are saying they are using science, while actually all their craft is working because of magic.
